services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: A-Bay Fishing Charters supplies all rods, reels and tackle for your fishing trip. At the end of a successful day of fishing your fish will be cleaned and packaged at no extra charge. As the international border splits the 1000 Islands region our guides will recommend either a NY or Ontario License based on the current fishing conditions. Please inquire with Captain Pat as to his preference. Both the NY & Ontario licenses can be purchased reasonably. Please Note: If You’re Going To Experience A Shore Dinner, Fishing Ends At

blurb: Guests fish for bass, northern pike, perch, and muskie aboard a 26' Chris Craft boat. The boat carries up to six people and is partially covered for weather protection. All rods, reels, and tackle are supplied, and fish are cleaned and packaged at no extra charge.
